ruleset.name: Stone Shelter proposed baseline
ruleset.description: Proposed, source-only rules. Semantic architecture remains an ArchUnit responsibility.

rule.name: StoneRecordMaxFourComponents
rule.message: Records may declare at most four components; use a mutable class for larger DTOs.
rule.description: Constitution 18: count declared record components, including nested records.

rule.name: StoneDtoPackage
rule.message: Request and Response types belong in lab.stoneshelter.shared.
rule.description: Constitution 11: checks conventionally named concrete DTO declarations.

rule.name: StoneLargeDtoPrivateFields
rule.message: Large shared DTOs must use private instance fields.
rule.description: Constitution 18: direct declared fields of shared classes; static fields excluded.

rule.name: StoneLargeDtoNoArgConstructor
rule.message: Large shared DTOs need an accessible no-argument constructor.
rule.description: Accepts an implicit default constructor or an explicit public zero-argument constructor.

rule.name: StoneLargeDtoAccessors
rule.message: Each large DTO field needs public instance getter and setter declarations.
rule.description: Checks declared accessor names/arity/non-void getter/void setter, not their bodies or exact types.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[matches(@PackageName, '^lab\.stoneshelter\.shared(\.|$)')] [count(ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()]/VariableDeclarator) > 4] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId[ let $suffix := concat(upper-case(substring(@Name, 1, 1)), substring(@Name, 2)), $body := ../../.. return not($body/MethodDeclaration[@Visibility = 'public'][@Static = false()] [@Arity = 0][@Void = false()] [@Name = concat('get', $suffix) or (@Name = concat('is', $suffix) and PrimitiveType[@Kind = 'boolean'])]) or not($body/MethodDeclaration[@Visibility = 'public'][@Static = false()] [@Arity = 1][@Void = true()][@Name = concat('set', $suffix)]) ]

rule.name: StoneMapperName
rule.description: Enforces the naming shape; semantic source/target correspondence requires type-aware review.

rule.name: StoneEntityMapperBase
rule.message: Entity-target mappers must directly extend AbstractEntityMapper.
rule.description: Checks direct syntactic inheritance; null-source behavior is verified by application tests.

rule.name: StoneDtoMapperBase
rule.message: DTO-target mappers must directly extend AbstractDtoMapper.
rule.description: Checks direct syntactic inheritance; technical null handling remains a tested invariant.

rule.name: StoneMapperReturnsValue
rule.message: toDto and toEntity transformations must return the resulting object.
rule.description: Checks conversion method return declarations; result use and protected hook semantics require review.

rule.name: StoneEntityUpdateOrder
rule.message: The two-argument toEntity overload must take the entity first.
rule.description: Checks concrete entity-named parameter types; generic base methods are excluded.

rule.name: StoneLayerImports
rule.message: This explicit import crosses a Stone Shelter layer boundary.
rule.description: Explicit import checks only; fully qualified, same-package and transitive dependencies need ArchUnit.

rule.name: StoneControllerConstruction
rule.message: Controllers must delegate structured object construction and mapping.
rule.description: Detects direct construction of conventionally named DTO/entity/criteria types in controllers.
